row.body: Outside studies are data in research/studies/<id>.json (finding, mechanisms with paths, metric, target, prediction). foundation/research.py measures each metric from the ledgers, files Q-RES items with the measurement as closing probe, settles experiments, proposes rule links via core/connect, writes research/papers and site/research-data.js (/research). Seeds: Chen and Stratton 2026 (review bottleneck; 5 of 7 met, not met: system-authored share 0.20, self deploys 0) and Ashby 1952 (3 of 5 met, not met: step-function share 0.27, second-loop kept share 0 of 14 verdicts). Weekly in scout.yml; papers regenerate after every merge.
